title: Handling Sum Queries After Update
summary: Given two arrays nums1 and nums2, and a series of queries, perform operations as specified.
statement: Given two arrays nums1 and nums2, and a series of queries, perform operations as specified. For type 1 queries, flip the bits in nums1 from l to r. For type 2 queries, update nums2 by adding the product of nums1 and p to each element of nums2. For type 3 queries, calculate the sum of nums2. Return the results of all type 3 queries.
constraints: Type 1 [1,l,r] flips every nums1 bit in the inclusive range.
Type 2 [2,p,0] adds p times the current nums1-one count to the total nums2 sum.
Type 3 records the current nums2 sum; return all recorded values.
hints: Only nums1's current count of ones and nums2's total sum are needed.
A lazy segment tree stores one counts and flips a covered node to segment length minus its count.
Propagate pending flips only before descending into a partially covered node.
Range flips remain logarithmic, and each type-two query uses the root count to update the scalar total exactly.
editorial: Range flips remain logarithmic, and each type-two query uses the root count to update the scalar total exactly.

tests.explanation: The flip makes three ones, so the update raises the sum to three.
The recorded sums are five before the flip and five afterward because no ones remain.
